name: AiLagoon
shortDescription: AI model hub — Ollama, ChatGPT, OpenRouter, with shareable Grapple capabilities
description: AiLagoon is the AI model-hub pearl for Melusina. Register multiple LLM providers (Ollama, ChatGPT, OpenRouter), manage per-model connections, and expose AI capabilities — ai-text, ai-vision, ai-generic, and direct per-model access — to other pearls via Grapple. HTTP-out to external providers is routed through the ai-lagoon sidecar via a single Sandstorm HTTP-out permission, not per-grain capability hops. Built-in playground for testing models without leaving the pearl.
